name: Stock Portfolio
description: Portfolio value, day change and gain/loss for your holdings, plus live quotes for a watchlist of stocks and indices

settingsSchema.description: Settings of the stock portfolio plugin. Holdings are edited in the plugin flyout.

positions.description: Your holdings. Structured entries are edited in the plugin flyout (Manage tab), not here.

buyPrice.description: Average purchase price per share, in the symbol's own currency; 0 hides the total gain

watchlist.description: Symbols quoted without a holding, e.g. "^GDAXI" (DAX), "^GSPC" (S&P 500), "MSFT"

baseCurrency.description: Currency of the portfolio total, e.g. "EUR", "USD", "CHF". Foreign holdings are converted with the provider's FX rate (Yahoo provider only).

provider.description: Quote source. "yahoo" needs no account (unofficial endpoint). "finnhub" needs a free API key in the plugin data folder, see the README.

refreshMinutes.description: Minutes between price updates; values below 1 are raised to 1 to stay inside the provider's rate limit

alertPercent.description: A popup fires when a symbol moved this far (in percent, either direction) since its last alert; 0 disables alerts. This threshold is the only frequency control.

coverLayout.description: How the bar tile shows the portfolio

tileRotate.description: Roll the tile through the portfolio total and every tracked symbol instead of showing the total only
